title: At the Airport
description: Find a gate, understand basic departure information, and answer check-in questions.
objectives: Find a gate, understand basic departure information, and answer check-in questions.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to find a gate, understand basic departure information, and answer check-in questions. The central language is travel questions and airport instructions. It belongs to the practical context of travel & accommodation. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A2, connect the main message to a time, reason, contrast, or result. Listen for context before choosing the tense or functional phrase. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: Which gate does the flight leave from?
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the at the airport exchange.

blocks.english: Could you help me with this problem?
blocks.explanation: Use this question or response to keep the at the airport exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “Which gate does the flight leave from?” and “Boarding begins at gate twelve.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled. Compare the time and viewpoint in each model, and use a linker when two ideas need a clear relationship. Avoid adding advanced forms when the lesson pattern already communicates the message accurately.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: travel questions and airport instructions.
